significance: One of the 108 Divya Desams, notable as one of the few historic Indian temples where Vishnu, Shiva and Brahma are all enshrined with their consorts in a single complex.
story: Shiva, wandering as the alms-seeking Bhikshatana, is said to have been fed to fullness here by Lakshmi, who thus earned the name Poornavalli.
